name: Gasthof Geislerhof
beschreibung: The Gasthof Geislerhof is situated in Vorderlanersbach in the municipality of Tux in the Zillertal valley. Set in a sunny hillside position at around 1,645 metres above sea level at the foot of the Rastkogel, this traditional mountain inn pairs authentic Tyrolean timber architecture with peaceful alpine scenery. The family-run property features cosy wood-panelled rooms and a scenic sun terrace overlooking the Tuxertal. In the welcoming restaurant, hearty local home cooking and regional Zillertal specialities are served. Marked hiking and biking trails into the Tux Alps start right at the doorstep, while nearby ski areas and the Hintertux Glacier are within easy reach in winter.
